decision.scope: Four first-party exports in zircon_reflect_derive/src and zircon_runtime/reflection_macros/src plus their discovered named helper/call sites and the inspected Runtime/interface consumer paths.
decision.finding: 已读第一方宏会收到普通 Rust doc 属性；两组 derive 只解析自己的 zr_reflect/zircon_script 辅助属性，普通 doc 不进入反射 documentation 值。函数/模块属性宏会回插普通 doc 属性，故 compiler-facing 输出仍变化。显式辅助属性或宏参数中的 documentation/doc 则真实进入运行时元数据。
decision.runtimeExpectation: 在合法 AST 形状、原 helper/macro 参数、类型/成员顺序/cfg/module 路径均保持的前提下，当前被检查的宏路径没有把新增普通 Rust 文档内容转成反射显示名/稳定 ID/字段槽位/序列化标记/回调签名/运行时 documentation 的分支。
decision.observableExplicitDocumentation: 显式 DSL doc 字符串会影响反射 DTO 和脚本描述符的文档字段、相关序列化/相等性、schema fingerprint 编码及 Markdown 导出。不能把这些配置字符串当成可随意改写的源码注释。
decision.coverageCredit: Focused readonly static auxiliary evidence only; no new source-comment coverage is claimed.
decision.acceptanceRecommendation: Root may use the path-bound static decision when assessing expected doc-attribute deltas. Keep formal Rustdoc/compiler/procedural-macro and third-party derive validation pending; do not force comments_only or claim compiler-facing token equality.
